C12 record -- the defect and the WRONG ARTIFACT, taken before the fix.

`vit verify CheckInputs ...` at ROSCO-r2 0b24c5c, VIT 6cd3c75.

CheckInputs is the first unit in this campaign whose kernel calls a callee
with an ALLOCATABLE dummy (AddToList) and the first whose kernel calls a
callee returning LOGICAL (NonDecreasing, bridged as int32_t). The generated
`vit_kernel_callees.h` names both types and declares neither:

--- kernel/CheckInputs/vit_kernel_callees.h, as generated ---------------------
// VIT: Kernel callee bridge declarations
// Auto-generated - allows C++ translations to call
// original Fortran functions via BIND(C) bridges.

#ifndef VIT_KERNEL_CALLEES_H
#define VIT_KERNEL_CALLEES_H

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

void addtolist_c(CFI_cdesc_t* list, int element);
int32_t nondecreasing_c(double* Array, int n_Array);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif // VIT_KERNEL_CALLEES_H
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

g++ -O2 -fPIC -ffp-contract=off -c checkinputs.cpp -o checkinputs.o
In file included from checkinputs.cpp:6:
vit_kernel_callees.h:12:6: error: variable or field 'addtolist_c' declared void
   12 | void addtolist_c(CFI_cdesc_t* list, int element);
      |      ^~~~~~~~~~~
vit_kernel_callees.h:12:18: error: 'CFI_cdesc_t' was not declared in this scope; did you mean 'CFI_CDESC_T'?
vit_kernel_callees.h:12:31: error: 'list' was not declared in this scope
vit_kernel_callees.h:12:37: error: expected primary-expression before 'int'
checkinputs.hpp:804:13: error: 'addtolist_c' was not declared in this scope
checkinputs.hpp:809:13: error: 'addtolist_c' was not declared in this scope
make: *** [Makefile:13: checkinputs.o] Error 1

WHY IT IS THE HEADER AND NOT THE TRANSLATION. checkinputs.cpp does include
<ISO_Fortran_binding.h>, at its own line 14 -- and VIT injects the callees
header at line 6, four lines ABOVE it. A translation cannot include a header
earlier than the line the tool injects. The g++ "did you mean CFI_CDESC_T"
is the proof the include is present but LATER: that macro comes from the very
header whose typedef is being reported missing.

THE OTHER LAYER GETS THIS RIGHT, WHICH IS WHY IT SURVIVED 28 UNITS.
`generate_c_wrapper` (interface_gen.py:91) emits `#include <ISO_Fortran_binding.h>`
when `cfi_args(sig)` is non-empty, and `vit_translated.h` -- the header the
INTEGRATED build uses -- carries it unconditionally. So `addtolist_c` has been
callable from an integrated translation since unit #1 and was never callable
from a kernel. The two headers exist for the same purpose and only one of them
was taught the rule.

NOT WORKED AROUND (X2). VIT is in this campaign's control. Fixed in
vit/interface_gen.py:generate_kernel_callees_header.
